entries.description: Spend a skill point here to unlock the ether skills.
Spend a skill point here to unlock the fire skills.
Spend a skill point here to unlock the air and storm skills.
Spend a skill point here to unlock the water and frost skills.
Spend a skill point here to unlock the earth skills.
Spend a skill point here to unlock the body skills.
Spend a skill point here to unlock the mind skills.

Throws a magic bolt of ethereal energy that follows enemies.
entries.quickDescription: a magic bolt that follows enemies

entries.description: Create faster and more accurate bolts.  Bolts will chase a new target if their current target is destroyed.
Throws more magic missiles in a single cast.
entries.quickDescription: fire more magic missiles per cast

entries.description: Rips a hole into the mapped B9-Epsilon(s) psuedoquadrant of the Ether, known habitation of Leviathan.
Your wizard steps halfway into the mapped 9th-Sigma pseudoquadrant of the ether, which is known to be devoid of matter.
entries.quickDescription: become one with the ether plane

entries.description: Magic missiles pierce through objects and enemies.
When not firing, your Magic Missile spell charges up an ether pulse that reduces the maximum health of enemies.
A quick and limited planar teleport in the direction you are facing.
entries.quickDescription: A limited teleport through the ether

entries.description: Hurls a ball of fire at enemies.
Explosions emit embers on impact.
Fireballs explode on impact, causing splash damage.
Imps emerge from spent embers to chase down enemies.
Causes embers to also explode.
Surrounds the caster with an expanding ring of fire and brimstone that pushes back enemies.
Fire damage ignites enemies, causing them to take burn damage for a few more seconds.
Your wizard leaves a trail of fire as he walks.
entries.quickDescription: drop a trail of fire behind you

entries.description: Throws an electric arc at enemies.
Causes lightning to arc to more enemies.
Lightning bolts hold enemies, slowing and stopping them.
Spawn a small but intense electro-magic thunderstorm.
entries.quickDescription: spawn a small but intense storm

entries.description: Upgrades your magic storm to a magic tornado.
Summons a hurricane while firing lightning.
Cast a manly prismatic miasma that makes foes more susceptible to lightning.
Lightning has a chance of instantly disintegrating an enemy whose health is below 20%
Throws a jet of cold air that frosts enemies.
entries.quickDescription: a jet of frost slows enemies

entries.description: The force of frost jet pushes enemies back, and can tumble arrows.
Widens and lengthens the frost jet.
Surrounds the caster with an expanding ring of ice that freezes enemies into immobility.
While firing Frost Jet, the wizard becomes coated in a layer of armor-enhancing ultra-ice.
entries.quickDescription: gain armor while firing frost jet

entries.description: While casting frost jet, your wizard is surrounded by an aura of cold that slows nearby enemies.
entries.quickDescription: frost jet chills air around caster

entries.description: Adds chunks of hail to frost jet.
Increases the slowdown effect of all cold and freeze spells.
Calls stones from the earth and binds them into a gigantic, destructive boulder.
Shaking the earth causes a tremendous disruption in your foe's ability to concentrate, pursue, and aim.
Speeds up the accumulation of the boulder.
Magically binds the rocks in the boulder tighter, allowing them to withstand more enemy impacts.
A chance to channel your earth spell perfectly, causing your boulder to spring forth at full size.
entries.quickDescription: a chance to grow boulders instantly

entries.description: Summons a golem to both deliver and receive beatings.
Temporarily renders your wizard impervious to all physical and magical harm.
Breaks the size ceiling on your rock binding, allowing you to achieve truly gargantuan boulders!
Immediately teleports your wizard to the safest place nearby.
Surrounds the caster with a magic circle that slows time, boosts healing, and boosts mana recovery.
entries.quickDescription: slows time, boosts life and mana

entries.description: Binds your primary spell into a trap that detonates when an enemy walks near.  The longer the trap lies idle, the more damage it does.
entries.quickDescription: bind a spell into a trap

entries.description: Attempts to dampen hostile magic in an area around the caster.
Combine the current traits of two elemental attacks to create a new spell.
A chance for your aura to respond with a dazzling flash when you are struck.
entries.quickDescription: dazzle enemies when you are struck

entries.description: Surrounds the caster with a bubble that absorbs all physical and magical damage.
Causes magic shield to explode when it breaks.
Increases your maximum mana.
Increases your rate of mana recovery.
Recover mana more quickly when standing still (and not firing).
Reduces the cost of all offensive spells.
Recharges all secondary skills faster.
Enhances the damage of all offensive spells.
Resists a portion of all magical attacks.
Provides more skill choices during level-up, and reduces requirements for all skills and items.
Increases your maximum health.
Enchants your staff with metaphysical energy so that it can deliver stronger melee hits.
Picks up items from further away
entries.quickDescription: pick up objects from farther away

entries.description: Increases your walking speed.
Your staff works to impose itself between you and harmful blows.
Reduces the duration of all poison attacks.
Increases your casting speed.
The sapience of the enchantment on your staff makes your pasty, pale wizard's body more effective at flailing around randomly.
Spawn a shower of hot acid.
entries.quickDescription: spawn a shower of hot acid

entries.description: Spawn a wall of burning flame.
Rips a hole into the mapped Theta(g)-27 psuedoquadrant of the Ether, known to have a severe pressure differential.
entries.quickDescription: Rip a consuming hole into the ether

entries.description: Fortifies your golem with iron spikes, reflecting damage back onto physical attackers.
entries.quickDescription: fortifies your golem with iron spikes

entries.description: Calls a large comet from the firmament, freezing enemies and dealing tremendous damage.
Weakens lesser undead and causes them to flee the caster for a time.
Supplements your cognitive nexus with certain magical energies, or possibly entities, boosting all skills.
Supplements your visceral node magically to increase your health recovery.
